films.title_mk: Екрани што се виткаат, свиткуваат и лебдат
films.title_en: Screens that roll, fold and float
films.desc_en: A rollable TV, a transparent pane, a foldable screen and a curved wall: one set of content for every shape.
Wrapped pillars, a curved car dashboard, an airport wall and a lit glass staircase.
Windows, shop glass and elevator walls that show more than the view.
